decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's existing formulation and pharmacy-market knowledge, this product fits its absorptive capacity well and should be learnable and improvable with low withdrawal risk after only one year.

This generic antidepressant is relatively distant from the firm's established strengths and strategic emphasis, so despite adequate manufacturing capability the weaker knowledge fit and limited scope for differentiated learning make discontinuation more likely.

A close product line with several models builds strongly on the firm's existing tablet, regulatory and commercial know-how, which raises its ability to refine the offer and lowers the chance of an early exit.

The supplement is related to the firm's self-care and pharmacy-focused business and supports its move toward differentiated health products, though its lower website prominence suggests a somewhat higher but still minority risk of being dropped.
